newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Shandong Xinhua seen pricing at HK$1.82 per share.
newsitem.headline: Shandong Xinhua seen pricing at HK$1.82 per share.

text.p: Shandong Xinhua Pharmaceutical Co Ltd is expected to price its H shares at HK$1.82 per share, representing a fully diluted prospective price to earnings multiple of 7.8 times, market sources said on Friday.
The Chinese state-owned medicine maker is expected to issue 140 million H shares -- 105 million for international placement and 35 million for public subscription in Hong Kong, they said.
H shares are shares of Chinese enterprises listed in Hong Kong.
If the issue is oversubscribed, sources said the company would issue an additional 10 million shares.
The Hong Kong flotation is expected to run from December 17-20, with dealing in the shares to begin on December 31, they said. Nomura International is expected to be the sponsor.

About HK$135 million of the proceeds would be used to upgrade and expand production capacity and HK$60 million to fund the development of new products. The remainder is expected to be used for debt repayment, sources said.
Shandong Xinhua, the last H share to be listed in the territory in 1996, is expected to hold a press briefing detailing its listing plan on Monday.
